Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations must replace MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, and entitlement policies to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. After this date, MemberOf-based updates will stop, impacting Conditional Access and related services.
